summary: Independence corroboration sweep of the batch-14 map (no re-derivation). New genuinely independent lineages found and checked against all 50 anchors: the TMDB/Netflix episode-overview set for all 50 episodes (event-level agreement everywhere, zero contradictions), a MAL S2 ep-20 thread pinning the Elsie/Justice kiss to ch 124 inside our ep 45, and ja fan press (newstisiki.com) independently confirming S2 = vols 9-16 with a sequel starting at vol 17 (i.e. ep 26 starts ch 69, ep 50 ends ch 140, continue 141). The only exact-END promotion is ep 18 (medium -> high): the TMDB ep-19 overview ('After obtaining the information they needed from Xiaomei, Edens Zero sets course for Sun Jewel') independently places ch 48's core event inside ep 18, which also settles batch-14 note 2 - ch 48 belongs to ep 18 as position instrument; ep 19's chapter-title-matching name is a naming artifact (its opening scene is ch 48's closing 3-page shipboard scene). MAL episode threads remain chapter-silent (9 sampled this session across both seasons; 1 hit), reddit is unreachable (reddit.com 403, pullpush.io hard 429 after two queries; r/EdensZero episode threads exist but carry only 0-32 comments each), ja.wikipedia's episode table has no chapter column, and the Wikipedia season articles are bracket-only. No repairs: nothing any independent source said contradicts a stored anchor, page split, or annotation.

flags_for_sean: Independence report (closes batch-14 note 1, partially): the single-lineage caveat is REDUCED, not eliminated. New independent lineage #1 - TMDB/Netflix episode overviews for all 50 episodes (https://www.themoviedb.org/tv/104711-edens-zero/season/1, one 50-episode season there): every overview's events sit inside the stored chapter range for its episode with ZERO contradictions (e.g. ep 26 opens 'after defeating Madame Kurenai and leaving Sun Jewel' = post-ch-68; ep 31 opens on Shiki's apparent death = ch 84 zone; ep 36 opens with Drakken already defeated = ch 99; ep 41 'leave Red Cave towards Foresta' = 112-114; ep 49 opens 'after Shura's Judgment Day declaration' = post-ch-134, seconding the ep 48/49 boundary). This is event/bracket-level corroboration for all 50 anchors but pins an exact END only at ep 18 (promoted). Page-level splits and most exact ENDs still rest on the edenszero.fandom ep-page/chapter-page pair; recommendation to apply the map stands, now with an independent no-contradiction sweep behind it.

ch 48 SETTLED (closes batch-14 note 2): ch 48 belongs to ep 18 as position instrument. Three-way agreement: (1) fandom ep 18 page gives ch 48 p.2-16 + final page p.20 to ep 18; (2) fandom ch 48 infobox reverse map: 'Episode 18 (p.1-14, p.18), Episode 19 (p.15-17)'; (3) independent TMDB/Netflix ep-19 overview says ep 19 starts after Xiaomei's information is obtained - and per the ch 48 summary that reveal IS the chapter's core, while the ep-19 slice (p.15-17) is only the closing shipboard scene where the crew charts course for Sun Jewel. Ep 19 carrying ch 48's title ('From the Planet of Eternity') is a Kodansha naming artifact for its cold open. Keep ep 18 END 48, ep 19 START 49, and both stored rearranged annotations exactly as they are.
